findings.summary: Root claim: article says the root of "Salat (صلاة)" is "تصل", but the corpus root is ص ل و.
findings.detail: The corpus records root ص ل و for "صلاة" (nearby forms also draw on ص ل ي, و ص ل, أ ص ل). "تصل" is not that root — it is likely a derived form, not the triliteral root.
